description: MPW Link resolves ROM references from exported labels. The completed image matches every reference byte.

historical_references.finding: The table contains linked offsets and calls for post-link compression.
The link places the dispatch table last.
A July 1986 change note names postlinker.a.
The header supplies the trap count before Hiram writes the checksum.
The source documents the encoding and retains its decoder.
The decoder reads the offset stored by PostLinker.

historical_limit: No PostLinker implementation was found in the local release. Reserving space and relinking adapts the documented process to the Plus layout.
